newsitem.title: USA: Simpson to buy Cummins Engine.
newsitem.headline: Simpson to buy Cummins Engine.

text.p: Simpson Industries Inc said on Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to buy the vibration attenuation unit of Cummins Engine Co Inc's unit Holset Engineering Co Ltd.

Holset's vibration attenuation unit supplies rubber dampers for light and medium-duty engines and viscous dampers for heavy-duty diesel engine customers. It has manufacturing operations in England, France, Spain, Mexico and Brazil.
The transaction was subject to certain conditions and was expected to be completed in the second quarter.

"This opportunity provides a platform for Simpson to gain a significant presence in Europe, South America and the Far East while expanding its product range in noise, vibration and harshness, a focus product line for Simpson," said Roy Parrott, Simpson's president and chief executive.
